layouts.name: CTopLevelWindow_WindowFrame_CloseButtonBitmaps
layouts.notes: CreateNCButtons populates this state array from normal close-button theme part 7; UpdateButtonVisuals reads its first state's content margins.

layouts.name: CTopLevelWindow_WindowFrame_Glyphs
layouts.notes: CreateGlyphsFromAtlas fills four variants, each with ten CBitmapSourceArray entries. The first entry is the close glyph; each array owns four states. UpdateButtonVisuals uses variant stride 320 and reads the first normal frame's close-glyph height. Later themes may use nonconsecutive part IDs, so read the created bitmap sources rather than deriving variants from part numbers.
